info_urls.title: Juice to fly past Earth for third gravity assist
info_urls.description: The European Space Agency’s Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (Juice) will return to Earth on 28 September, with flight controllers guiding the spacecraft close to our home planet to alter its speed and direction en route to Jupiter.

results.name: International Space Station Operations Update Media Teleconference

vid_urls.title: Space Station Operations Update (Sept. 28, 2026)
vid_urls.description:
Leaders from NASA and Boeing hold a news conference at NASA's Kennedy Space Center to provide updates on Starliner development and plans for crew flights to and from the International Space Station. 

Briefing participants include:
 
* NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman
* Dana Weigel, manager, NASA’s Low Earth Orbit Program
* Woody Hoburg, NASA astronaut
* John Mulholland, vice president and program manager, Boeing Commercial Crew

Learn more about the Commercial Crew Program: https://www.nasa.gov/commercialcrew
Get daily updates from the station: https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/

results.description:
During a news conference at 3 p.m. EDT on Monday, Sept. 28, NASA and Boeing leadership will discuss Starliner’s development and plans for regular crew flights to and from the International Space Station.

The briefing participants include:

* NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman
* Dana Weigel, manager, NASA’s Low Earth Orbit Program
* Woody Hoburg, NASA astronaut
* John Mulholland, vice president and program manager, Boeing Commercial Crew
